effect_description_eng:
While you have an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon or Tamer on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your level 5 or higher Digimon would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
